test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Exactly three people are sitting to the left of U. R is second to the left of U. Q and V are immediate neighbours of R, such that Q is not an immediate neighbour of U. T and P are not occupying either of the end seats. T is second to the left of S. If P and Q swap their seats, what will be the new position of Q?

options.text: Second to the right of R
Second to the left of V
Third to the left of U
Second to the right of U

solution:
Given: Seven people P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

1) Exactly three people are sitting to the left of U.

2) R is second to the left of U.

3) Q and V are immediate neighbours of R, such that Q is not an immediate neighbour of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a05fcf44e530a864c3f5ccfed70412c3c5a764c5d7270b6e7a2ecdcd93b0f2ed.png] 

4) T and P are not occupying either of the end seats.

5) T is second to the left of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/377480f2e39eec1f1c65a30b330f814a88886789a6be1845894434370fe5a05a.png] 

Here, If P and Q swap their seats,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4dbb5b51d946dec27483e630ed9e7dc811b74708c3ffeec56f6f79693d247249.png] 

So, Q will sits **'**Second to the right of U' after swap the positions of P and Q.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
